description: Add or subtract years/months/weeks/days/business days/hours/minutes/seconds from a date. Month-end clamping; business days skip weekends, given holidays, and the public holidays of an optional country. Use for due dates, deadlines, delivery estimates, expiry and "N working days from today". First 25 calls per day are free, then $0.001 per call (x402).

inputSchema.description: Negative values subtract. Months clamp to month end (Jan 31 + 1 month = Feb 28/29). Time units require a datetime input.

business_days.description: Applied after calendar units; skips rest days (see workdays) and holidays

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (207 countries); its public holidays (2000–2050) are excluded from business days

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD, or ISO 8601 datetime with Z or offset

holidays.description: Extra dates excluded from business-day counts (rest days from workdays are always excluded)

workdays.description: Working days of the week, 0 = Sunday. Default [1,2,3,4,5] (Mon–Fri); e.g. [0,1,2,3,4] for Sun–Thu or [1,2,3,4,5,6] for Mon–Sat

name: date_add

result.description: YYYY-MM-DD, or ISO datetime (UTC) for datetime input

title: Add to a date
